about.en: PAIR is the token of pair.fund, a permissionless token launchpad on Robinhood Chain that creates fixed-supply ERC-20 tokens with permanently locked Uniswap V4 markets paired against stock tokens or other ERC-20 quote tokens. It is an ERC-20 on Robinhood Chain at 0x6b1d42927b1a84ec28fa88d4fc6fa7af404966be.
